title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-31 19:43:51 最新章节：第308章 上古十科求贵人
content_zh:
大周仙朝，青云府，惠春县。
苏家村的一处青砖阔院里，日头偏西，余晖透过雕花的窗棂，斑驳地洒在架子床前。
苏秦只觉脑中一阵昏沉，像是被人闷头敲了一记闷棍，耳畔嗡嗡作响。
他费力地撑开眼皮，入目是有些发黄的承尘，鼻尖萦绕着一股淡淡的艾草焚烧后的烟火气。
“醒了？”
一道醇厚却略带沙哑的男声在耳边响起。
苏秦扭过头。
床边坐着个身穿靛青色长衫的中年男子，手里捏着个紫砂茶壶，面皮有些黑，眼角的皱纹里夹着常年在地里劳作洗不净的尘土气，看着极是敦厚。
这人正是他这一世的父亲，苏海。
苏海见儿子睁眼，紧绷的肩膀松垮下来，把茶壶往那红木方桌上一搁，磕出“笃”的一声脆响。
“感觉咋样？胸口还闷不闷？”
苏海探过身子，伸手要去摸苏秦的额头，手伸到半空又缩了回去，似是怕手上的茧子磨坏了读书人的皮肉:
“大夫刚走，说是元气亏空，也就是俗话说的累脱了力。你说你这孩子，修行法术哪是能急得来的事？”
苏秦张了张嘴，喉咙干涩，发不出声。
苏海叹了口气，起身倒了一碗温水，递到苏秦嘴边
“喝口水润润。不是爹说你，咱们苏家是小门小户，虽说供得起你读道院，可也没指望你一定要考进内阁去做大官。”
“考不上二级院，明年再考就是了，留级也不丢人，身子骨最重要，下次别这么急了。”
温水入喉，苏秦的思绪渐渐清明。
记忆如潮水般涌入。
前世的他，是一个视红牛赞助为毕生梦想的极限运动狂人，在一次定点无伞跳伞挑战中，因为风向的微小偏差，直接拍在了岩壁上。

再睁眼，便到了这大周仙朝。
这里不是他熟悉的任何一个朝代。
大周仙朝，立国八百载，太祖宏愿，布道天下。
这听起来像是神话传说，落到实处，却是一套严密得令人发指的科举修仙体系。
凡大周子民，皆可修行。
但“可”与“能”，中间隔着银山铜海。
平民百姓想要出头，唯有进道院。
道院分三级一级院启蒙，二级院进修，三级院深造。
唯有三级院毕业，拿到导师教习亲笔签名的推荐信，才有资格参加大周仙朝的全国统考。
考过了，便是大周的官。
但这官，不是凡俗的官，而是执掌天地权柄的神。
农司的官，掌管一方水土肥力、庄稼生长；
水司的官，册封为河伯水神，调理旱涝；
阴司的官，便是城隍土地，管辖一方阴魂秩序。
一切伟力，归于大周。
一切法术，皆需持证。
content_en:
Dazhou Immortal Dynasty, Qingyun Mansion, Huichun County.
In a wide courtyard with green bricks in Sujia Village, the sun is setting to the west, and the afterglow shines mottledly on the canopy bed through the carved window lattice.
Su Qin felt a sense of drowsiness in his head, as if someone had hit him on the head with a sap, and there was a buzzing in his ears.
He struggled to open his eyelids, and what he saw was the yellowish Chengchen, and a faint smell of smoke from burning mugwort lingered on the tip of his nose.
"Are you awake?"
A mellow but slightly hoarse male voice sounded in his ears.
Su Qin turned his head.
Sitting next to the bed was a middle-aged man wearing an indigo gown, holding a purple sand teapot in his hand. His face was a little dark, and the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes contained the dusty smell that could not be washed away from years of working in the fields. He looked extremely honest.
This person is his father in this life, Su Hai.
When Su Hai saw his son open his eyes, his tense shoulders relaxed, and he put the teapot on the mahogany square table with a crisp sound.
"How do you feel? Is your chest still tight?"
Su Hai leaned over and reached out to touch Su Qin's forehead. He stretched his hand into the air and then retracted it, as if he was afraid that the calluses on his hands would abrade the scholar's skin:
"The doctor has just left. He said he was depleted of vitality, which is what the saying goes: he lost his strength due to fatigue. Do you think you, kid, can practice magic in a hurry?"
Su Qin opened his mouth, his throat was dry and he couldn't make a sound.
Su Hai sighed, stood up, poured a bowl of warm water, and handed it to Su Qin's mouth.
"Drink some water to moisten it. It's not what dad said to you. Our Su family is a small family. Although we can afford you to study in a Taoist academy, we don't expect you to be admitted to the cabinet and become a high official."
"If you don't get into the second-level college, just take the exam again next year. There's no shame in repeating a grade. Your body and bones are the most important thing. Don't be so hasty next time."
As the warm water entered his throat, Su Qin's thoughts gradually became clear.
Memories came flooding back.
In his previous life, he was an extreme sports fanatic who regarded Red Bull sponsorship as his lifelong dream. During a fixed-point skydiving challenge, he was photographed directly on the rock wall due to a slight deviation in the wind direction.
When he opened his eyes again, he arrived at the Great Zhou Immortal Dynasty.
This was not any dynasty he was familiar with.
The Immortal Dynasty of the Great Zhou Dynasty was established for eight hundred years. Taizu had great ambitions to preach to the world.
This sounds like a myth, but in reality, it is an outrageously rigorous imperial examination system for cultivating immortality.
All people of the Great Zhou Dynasty can practice it.
But "can" and "can" are separated by a mountain of silver and a sea of ​​copper.
If ordinary people want to get ahead, they can only enter the Taoist temple.
Taoist academies are divided into three levels: the first-level academy for enlightenment, the second-level academy for further education, and the third-level academy for further study.
Only those who graduate from a third-level college and receive a recommendation letter signed by their instructor are eligible to participate in the national unified examination of the Great Zhou Immortal Dynasty.
If you pass the exam, you will be an official in the Great Zhou Dynasty.
But this official is not an ordinary official, but a god who holds the authority of heaven and earth.
The officials of the Agricultural Department are in charge of the soil and water fertility and the growth of crops;
The official of the Water Department was conferred the title of Hebo Water God to regulate droughts and floods;
The official of the Yin Division is the City God, who governs the order of the Yins.
All great power belongs to the Great Zhou Dynasty.
All spells require a certificate.
